title: ReleaseSource

origin.description: A forge origin: https, or http for a LAN or tailnet instance, then the host in lower case and a port only when it is not the scheme's default (https://git.example.com:5526); no userinfo, path or trailing slash.

kind.description: The kind of forge the origin is, which the releases are read with.

repository.description: The repository the releases are published on, owner/name.

description: Where the environment reads its releases: the forge's origin and kind, and the repository, owner/name; compiled into each build.
